title: [Master]-When Intrastat line is added manually the "Intrastat Country/Region Code" is not automatically populated after adding the "Country/Region Code"
summary: The Intrastat Country/Region Code field now automatically populates when users manually enter a Country/Region Code on an Intrastat Report line, matching the behavior when lines are suggested.
key_points: Added OnValidate trigger to Country/Region Code field on Intrastat Report Line table
Derives Intrastat Country/Region Code automatically when a Country/Region Code is entered
Ensures manual line creation populates the Intrastat code field like the Suggest Lines feature
Resolves inconsistent behavior between manual entry and suggested lines
quote: When an Intrastat Report line is added manually, the Intrastat Country/Region Code stays blank after the user enters the Country/Region Code.
